about: Rules for colour and light per shot. Hard numbers (palette coverage, cool/warm ratio, luminance) are measured in code and stated in the unit; Jev judges fit to the beat and the arc. Source: bible palette arc.

rules.q: The colour of this shot fits its place in the palette arc (amber and char before the drop, white water at the drop, a clean cool sky only after the climb-out).
The frame has one calm rest area (smoke, sky or a wall of haze) where the eye can rest.
Every light in the frame has a source in the world (the low sun through smoke, fire from below, the windows of the cockpit); nothing is lit by an invisible studio light.
The only saturated man-made colour is the tanker's yellow and red, and the only near-white is the water and the steam.
